messages:
jess (prod-eng): planning to enable orbit-13b-v2 in catalog tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. goal: replace a noisy quant variant with the new runtime-optimized build.
jess (prod-eng): deploybot scheduled the enable for 02:15 UTC, canary at 5% traffic then ramp to 50% after 30m if healthy.
dan (serving): what fallback ordering are we using when orbit-13b-v2 is unhealthy? I want explicit ladder so traffic doesn't hit legacy-8b unexpectedly.
lee (ml-infra): propose fallback ladder: orbit-13b-v1 (compatible runtime) -> orbit-11b-quant (cost-optimized) -> legacy-8b for emergency only. keep legacy-8b deprioritized (weight 0.01).
priya (sre): add SLO-based automatic rollback: cpu_util > 85% for 10m OR p50 latency > 600ms for 5m -> trigger canary drain and rollback. who owns the rollback run? :raised_hand:
marco (oncall): I'll own rollback during the window. put me on the ops rotation for the next 48h after cutover.
deploybot: /schedule enable-model orbit-13b@v2 --catalog=stable --canary=0.05 --ramp=0.50 --regions=us-west,eu-central --fallbacks=orbit-13b@v1,orbit-11b-quant@v3,legacy-8b@v2 --start=3856005300
jess (prod-eng): deploybot, please annotate release notes with the perf delta and known model-behavior diffs.
deploybot: scheduled: orbit-13b@v2 enable at 02:15 UTC (start ts 3856005300). canary window 30m. auto-rollback hooks enabled.
erin (pm): for release notes, add: "improved long-sequence throughput; slight change in tokenization for some code prompts". also note embedding vector format unchanged.
sam (research): watch for hallucination diffs on system prompt A. we saw a 0.6% shift in a small eval in staging. add eval set "sys-A-smoke" to post-cutover daily suite.
lee (ml-infra): adding eval: `jobs trigger eval --suite=sys-A-smoke --freq=daily --postcutover=48h`
priya (sre): telemetry checks to add to canary dashboard: p50/p95 latency, error rate 5xx, GPU mem pressure, kv-cache hit-rate. set alert thresholds: p95 > 1200ms OR 5xx > 0.5% -> paging.
opsbot: telemetry hooks added to canary dashboard. alerting rules patched. pager routing -> oncall:marco, backup:oncall:lee.
dan (serving): question: do we pin any critical customers to the v1 variant during rollout? some enterprise tenants still on stable v1.
jess (prod-eng): yes — pin list: ent-corp-a, ent-bank-b at 100% to orbit-13b@v1 for first 24h. add to rollout config.
deploybot: /pin ent-corp-a=orbit-13b@v1 --duration=24h
deploybot: /pin ent-bank-b=orbit-13b@v1 --duration=24h
sam (research): will embedding vectors change shape? erin said format unchanged but confirm dimension/normalization.
erin (pm): confirmed: dimension 1536, no normalization changes. include note in release blurb.
marco (oncall): rollback checklist: 1) flip catalog weight to v1-canary; 2) drain v2 nodes; 3) revert canary pins; 4) run smoke evals. I'll run step 1/2 if pager fires.
lee (ml-infra): add small snippet for emergency CLI to do quick fallback reorders:

```
redwood catalog reorder --model orbit-13b@v1 --promote --fallbacks orbit-11b-quant@v3,legacy-8b@v2
```

priya (sre): add runbook entry: if p50 latency jump and kv-cache hit-rate drops > 20% do immediate rollback. record boolean decision in the incident channel.
jess (prod-eng): who will update the user-facing changelog? erin?
erin (pm): I'll post the changelog and the short FAQ about behavior diffs right after the canary passes 30m.
dan (serving): one more: any scheduler extras for EU region? we expect higher token lengths there.
lee (ml-infra): EU will start at 2% canary for first 15m then 10% for 30m before joining global ramp. config attached.
jess (prod-eng): final checklist: deploybot scheduled (done), pins set (done), telemetry hooks (done), oncall assigned (marco), release notes (erin). good to go. leaving this thread open for any last-minute objections.
sam (research): logged the sys-A-smoke eval and will post the first run results in #eng-ml once available.
marco (oncall): I'll be near my laptop for the window. ping me directly if alert fires. :phone:
jess (prod-eng): thanks everyone. if no objections by EOD UTC we'll proceed with the schedule. :rocket:
